I am a PhD student in psychology at University of Bern, working on forensic metascience.

My work focuses on developing, implementing, and validating statistical methods to check published work for errors. I wrote the [scrutiny](https://lhdjung.github.io/scrutiny/) R package for the GRIM and GRIMMER tests.
